WE ARE HIRING
Join our Professional Team
Chartered Accountancy Practice
Ponda, Goa.
Positions

1. AUDIT MANAGER – Bank & Internal Audit
Qualification: CA / CA Final / CMA (Preference to qualified)
Experience: 6+ years in a CA firm with exposure to Bank Audit and Internal Audit
Key Responsibilities:
Manage and guide audit executives on field
Plan and execute bank and internal audit assignments
Ensure timely completion of audits (monthly / quarterly)
Review audit working papers and reports
Address client and bank queries
Identify and report control weaknesses / irregularities
Coordinate with bank officials and client management

2. PRACTICE OPERATIONS MANAGER – CA / CMA
Qualification: CA / CMA (Qualified)
Experience: 6+ years in a CA firm
Key Responsibilities:
Oversee day-to-day professional operations
Supervise and guide the team
Ensure timely completion of assignments and compliance deadlines
Review work in GST, Income Tax, TDS, ROC and Accounting
Manage client relationships
Monitor staff productivity and work quality
Implement processes and systems for efficient practice management

3. SENIOR ACCOUNTS EXECUTIVE – Independent Finalization
Qualification: B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CA Final / CMA Inter / CMA Final
Experience: 4+ years in a CA firm with independent finalization experience
Key Responsibilities:
Handle complete bookkeeping and ledger scrutiny
Perform bank reconciliation, debtors / creditors reconciliation
Manage GST and TDS accounting
Prepare trial balance and year-end adjustments
Independently finalize Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet
Coordinate with auditors and address queries
Work on Tally Prime and MS Excel

Last Date to Apply: 27th Oct 2026

Every applicant will receive an email after submitting the application, which must be responded to.

Send your resume to: hr@camanisha.com

For further details, reach us on: 9527938138
